notes.title: Hero.EXE Demo Overhaul Update 0.0.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37627393/50f38313c85bc9a4155959499a413633f4550cc3.png[/img]

Hey Pilots! Long time no see-- here's a nice juicy update to our Demo, complete with a massive Art & Animation overhaul! 

[b]Changelog:[/b]

+ Character Art Overhaul (incorporating Spine2D animation system)
+ Combat Stage Art Overhaul
+ Combat Projectile VFX Art Overhaul
+ New Cards added to the Pool
+ New Enemy Variants added
+ Partial Controller Support added (Combat-Only currently, still undergoing refinement)
+ Remappable Controls added to Options
+ Further SFX backend system improvements
+ Improvements and adjustments to VN Scenes
+ Improvements and adjustments to SFX
+ Various minor Bugfixes and Gameplay feel refinements
- Further reduced frequency of Random Encounters

[b]Known issues:
[/b]

- Phantom Tile highlights can occasionally be triggered by Health Volcano and Charge Attack
- Grenade projectiles can occasionally get stuck spinning
- Lovely.ldy enemy will occasionally not finish her attack animation


To see our Development Progress, check out our latest Kickstarter Update Post: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/heroexegame/heroexe/posts/3736557

And if you'd like to give us your feedback, or encounter any bugs you'd like to report, come find us on our Community Discord-- let's chat! http://discord.gg/BHk2fJ6

[b]EPILEPSY WARNING: Post-Credits scene has some flashing![/b]

notes.title: Hero.EXE Demo Update 0.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]Notes[/h1]

[b]VN character size adjusted[/b]
We adjusted the characters to be a bit smaller 

[b]Charge attack adjusted[/b]
The Charge attack was not consistently firing. We've adjusted them

[b]New credits video added[/b]
We added the new credits video at the end of the demo. We'll be adding the new VA lines soon. 

[b]Broken tile time reduced by half[/b]
We got some feed back that the broken tiles lasted to long so we adjusted them to half their original time. 

[b]Valentine talks less during combat[/b]
Valentine will now speak less during combat encounters. 

[b]Added new VN illustrations[/b]
Added 2 new illustrations to the Meet the merchants scene.

[b]Crack cards no longer crack the tile you are standing on[/b]
When using wave based crack cards the card would also crack the tile you are standing on. Now all projectiles start on the tile in front of you.

[b]More SFX added[/b]
We added a few more sound effects to the game in various spots.

notes.title: Hero.EXE
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/80gbRr8/capsule-lg6.png[/img]
[h1]Welcome to another internet![/h1]
Hero.EXE a card collecting action RPG that combines elements from visual novels, trading card games, and strategic grid-fighter combat. After connecting your PC to the internet of another world, you encounter artificial beings called "Ava" to navigate the net. Pilot carefully as your choices have a profound impact on your Ava's psyche and performance in combat. Work together with your Ava through their story to discover the secrets of a strange phenomenon enveloping the internet world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37627393/3767f5687655f377c7084554b02285d391d7c4cf.gif[/img]
[h1]The Demo[/h1]
Meet your new Ava connection, Valentine. 

Valentine will guide you through a new digital world full of secrets, friends, and foes. 
As you explore through the Tako server world, help Valentine choose the right path towards the tether while fighting through glitches and collecting codes to fit your unique style of gameplay. If a situation seems hairy, don't worry! Valentine may have a special ability to aid you on the journey... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37627393/a103fd842886d3d03e2533a57eb24a22e634dc9e.png[/img]

Hero.EXE a card collecting action RPG that combines elements from visual novels, trading card games, and strategic grid-fighter combat. After connecting your PC to the internet of another world, you encounter artificial beings called "Ava" to navigate the net. Pilot carefully as your choices have a profound impact on your Ava's psyche and performance in combat. Work together with your Ava through their story to discover the secrets of a strange phenomenon enveloping the internet world!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/bLZj7Y9/whoareyou.png[/img]
We are Mystery Egg Games, a small independent game studio with members all over the world! Mystery Egg Games Started in 2016 when a group of college friends decided to publish a videogame together, starting with our first, relatively small Steam game: GUNGUNGUN. 
Hero.EXE is our first large scale project as an expanded team around the globe, with a full-fledged story and a lot of snarky internet people. 

Thanks for tuning in!
